Additional gaps: (a) no explicit guidance to derive terminal-state set empirically from reference output size when ambiguous, (b) no warning against self-consistent cross-language validation, (c) session-gap boundary inclusivity (events exactly 10 min apart) still worth re-stating, (d) ensuring custom SourceFunctions emit Watermark.MAX_WATERMARK on close so final sessions fire on bounded input.
skills.repair_instruction: Augment the existing 'Flink Session-Window Pipelines for Google Cluster-Trace Analytics' section with a prominent 'Resolving terminal-state ambiguity' subsection: (1) Default to event_type==4 (FINISH) ONLY as 'job finished' — this is the strictest and most common interpretation; (2) If the task description says 'finished' without qualification, treat as FINISH only; if it says 'terminated' or 'completed (success or failure)', include {FINISH=4, FAIL=3, KILL=5} and verify whether LOST=6 is terminal per the trace README; (3) When reference output is available, use its row count to disambiguate: count distinct job_ids per candidate terminal-state set and pick the matching cardinality; (4) Add a 'Self-validation warning': do NOT validate a Flink Java implementation by writing a Python reimplementation that shares the same assumptions — both will agree on wrong semantics. Instead, (i) hand-trace 2–3 small jobs end-to-end from raw CSV to expected output, (ii) diff against the provided reference output file if any, (iii) vary the terminal-state set and SUBMIT-dedup policy as ablations and pick the one matching reference. Also re-emphasize: EventTimeSessionWindows.withGap(Time.minutes(10)) splits when gap STRICTLY exceeds 10 min; microsecond timestamps MUST be divided by 1000; count every SUBMIT (event_type==0) without deduplicating by task_index; custom SourceFunction must call ctx.emitWatermark(Watermark.MAX_WATERMARK) on close; use env.setParallelism(1) and a single-writer FileSink producing lines formatted exactly as '(jobId,count)' with no spaces or trailing commas; register a Long.MAX_VALUE-1 event-time timer in the KeyedCoProcessFunction to flush pending state on bounded input.
